text:
maria: Customer (acme-inc) hits intermittent 500s on /v1/completions, asking where to find the request/trace id to share with us. Window: Mar 10 14:22-14:26 UTC. They say mobile + server calls. Any quick repro steps I can send?
jun: Quick checklist to ask the customer for: 1) exact timeframe (you have that) 2) one curl reproduction with a custom X-Request-ID header 3) example response headers from the failed request 4) one server/mobile log line that shows the request id 5) (optional) a HAR or debug bundle. Keep it short.
eric: Curl example I send customers:```bash
curl -v https://api.redwood.example/v1/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: acme-test-12345" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-7b","input":"hi","max_tokens":16}'
```Then ask them to paste back the response headers (the `-v` output). We look for `x-request-id` or `x-redwood-request-id` in the response. If the response doesn't include it, ask for the server log line that handled the outbound request (search for the same id). Example server log snippet to look for:```text
INFO  2026-03-10T14:23:01Z request_id=acme-test-12345 status=500 path=/v1/completions model=open-7b latency_ms=312
```
maria: Mobile notes to include for the customer: Android — run `adb logcat | grep -i redwood` or `adb logcat | grep acme-test-12345`. Our Android SDK logs requests with tag `RedwoodSDK` and includes `request_id=...` in debug. For iOS use the device console (`Console.app` on mac or `idevicesyslog`) and search for `request_id` or `RedwoodSDK`.
eric: Console (web) route for our support team: Open Redwood Console -> Requests -> set time range -> use filter `request.id == "acme-test-12345"` or search by endpoint `/v1/completions`. If they can't find it, expand the window by ±5 minutes. Note: request IDs are indexed for 7 days.
jun: If they can't run curl, ask them to copy the exact response headers from their app's network tab (or server access logs). Also ask them to redact any API keys before pasting. If they can produce a HAR, have them attach it (DevTools -> Network -> Save as HAR) rather than screenshots.
eric: If they prefer to generate a debug bundle: tell them to enable SDK debug logging (set env `REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=debug` or `logLevel: 'debug'` in our client config), reproduce the error once, then attach the log file. For server side, search ingress logs for `acme-test-12345` or the timestamp range.
maria: I'll ping the customer with a short template: 1) Run the curl with `X-Request-ID` and paste the full `-v` output headers. 2) Find one server / mobile log line containing that id. 3) If possible attach HAR or debug logs (with API keys redacted). 4) Confirm org id and exact time window.
support-bot: Ticket #T-6123 created and linked to thread (esc: ops). :thumbsup:
maria: Thanks — will update here when customer replies. If they give an id I can't find, I'll paste it here and ask infra to search raw logs.
